title: 12 Best Deep Ellum and Bishop Arts District Craft Cocktail Bars in Dallas
description: Explore Dallas's vibrant craft cocktail scene in Deep Ellum and Bishop Arts. Discover top bars from mezcal-forward lounges to hidden speakeasies and prohibition-era gems. Your guide to Dallas's buzziest drinks.
category: Deep Ellum and Bishop Arts District Craft Cocktail Bars

places.name: Black Swan Saloon
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the bartender for a bespoke cocktail based on your favorite spirits and flavor profiles. You won't be disappointed.

places.name: Paradiso
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Bishop Arts Spritz' is a refreshing and popular choice, or try one of their seasonal creations.

places.name: Hide Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Old Fashioned' is consistently praised, or venture into their 'Dealer's Choice' for a surprise.

places.name: Botanist
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try anything with gin or a unique herbal infusion, as their 'Garden Party' is a perennial favorite.

places.name: Truth & Alibi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Alibi' cocktail is a signature, but any of their classics are expertly prepared.

places.name: Tejas
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A 'Mezcal Old Fashioned' or any of their unique mezcal-based margaritas.

places.name: Armory D.E.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try a pálinka-based cocktail or their spin on a classic, infused with European flavors.

places.name: Atlas
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask for a recommendation based on your favorite travel destination or preferred spirit. Their 'Kyoto Garden' is a standout.

places.name: Yellow Rosa Cantina
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Smoky Margarita' or any of their paloma variations are highly recommended.

places.name: Ladylove
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Ladylove Spritz' or ask for a bespoke gin creation; they excel with juniper-based spirits.

places.name: High Fives
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Cucumber Gimlet' is incredibly refreshing, or a classic 'Moscow Mule'.

places.name: Casablanca
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their gin or rum-based cocktails with exotic spices, like the 'Souk Spice' or 'Tangier Breeze'.

tags: Deep Ellum and Bishop Arts District Craft Cocktail Bars
